extension.title: LightOxygen settings
extension.description: Settings for the LightOxygen style, under Extensions in the admin panel. The style keeps its defaults while this extension is disabled.
extension.author: PanBB
extension.note: The web server needs write access to FORUM_ROOT/img/ (uploads go to img/lightoxygen/).
Uninstalling removes the LightOxygen settings and the uploaded hero, logo and favicon images.
